items.text: Within the next seven days, at least three more V4 hook pools with non-standard fee tiers (either zero or maximum) will be deployed by the same deployer address or its affiliates, continuing the pattern of strategic testing.
Within seven days, at least three more hook contracts will appear with custom tickSpacing below 10, mimicking the microscope pool at block 25326706.
Within seven days, at least one of the two stable pools (0x8abdde86 or 0xa778c93f) will see a significant liquidity deposit as hooks compete for early dominance.
Within seven days, at least one new hook contract will be deployed on Ethereum mainnet V4 pools, likely for dynamic fee or MEV protection, as builders test the joker's power.
Within seven days, the hook 0x1b15...aacc will deploy at least five more pools with the same pattern or a new token suffix.
Within seven days, at least one of the zero-fee pools deployed on block 25297090 will see its first swap, triggered by a hook-based strategy rather than organic flow.

Within seven days, the hook contract at 0x9963ad53742fb596bc9c1ae5178d850b05d10144 will execute its first non-trivial call—either a fee override or a liquidity rebalance—revealing the pool's intended strategy.
